events.title: Scorpio Tankers (STNG) Beats Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: Scorpio Tankers (STNG) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +10.75% and +3.93%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Seacor Marine (SMHI) Reports Q1 Loss, Lags Revenue Estimates
events.body: Seacor Marine (SMHI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +33.70% and -10.23%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
